favorites.name: Italian Sausage & Sweet Potato Bake
favorites.recipe_summary: Sheet pan bake with Italian sausage, cubed sweet potatoes, and seasonal vegetables roasted together.

favorites.name: Blueberry Protein Baked Oatmeal
favorites.recipe_summary: Baked oatmeal with vanilla protein powder and blueberries. 47g protein / 8g fiber per serving. Reheats in air fryer in 5 min. Top with Greek yogurt, honey, cinnamon.
favorites.notes: Full recipe in recipe-library.json. Not yet queued for meal planner.

favorites.name: Homemade Quesarito
favorites.recipe_summary: Copycat Taco Bell Quesarito with homemade chipotle sauce, nacho cheese, seasoned rice, taco meat, and sour cream in a toasted double-tortilla wrap.
favorites.notes: First meal plan inclusion. v2: scaled to 6 servings with 2 lbs ground beef (mixed dish — tortillas/cheese/rice carry volume).

favorites.name: Smash Burgers
favorites.recipe_summary: Thin smashed beef patties on a hot griddle with melted cheddar, pickles, and brioche buns.
favorites.notes: 2 lbs ground beef is right for 6 servings. Recipe naturally called for 1.5 lbs — scale up slightly but don't override.

favorites.name: One-Pot Creamy Penne with Italian Sausage
favorites.recipe_summary: Creamy one-pot penne with Italian sausage. Huge hit with all four family members.
